iti10:1.1: 10 vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatāti me sutaṃ
iti10:2.1: dosaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya
iti10:2.2: dosañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyāti.
iti10:4.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutanti.
